author: psykzz
name: When
short: Reply to time expressions with Discord timestamps
description: Detects common relative and weekday time expressions in enabled channels, replies with a relative Discord timestamp, and lets original posters manage or opt out of replies.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild settings, message IDs, bot reply IDs, and guild-specific user preferences to keep timestamp replies synchronized after edits and honor reply opt-outs.
